text: Sally decided to try to rest, but just a minute after she closed her eyes, she felt the tiny yet heavy body of her niece jump on her stomach. <break time="0.8s" /> Sawwy, Wake up, Wucy is here, she screamed in Sallys face. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing her niece, she laughed, You are a mean little thing, you know that, You so rudely interrupted my rest, Lucy. <break time="0.8s" /> Lucy pouted. <break time="0.8s" /> But I here now, You have to pway wiff me. <break time="0.8s" /> Sally could not stay mad at her if she tried, and she was trying. <break time="0.8s" /> Girly, you need to learn how to say your Ls, You are gonna be in school next year. <break time="0.8s" /> Sally picked her niece up and carried her out of her room. <break time="0.8s" /> The sounds of the family were already loud as she neared the main living space, holding the little girl in her arms. <break time="0.8s" /> The layout was completely open aside from the dining room, which was behind the kitchen. <break time="0.8s" /> It worked great for bigger gatherings. <break time="0.8s" /> The massive island between the kitchen and living room was covered with all kinds of finger foods. <break time="0.8s" /> Hmm, this is new, Sally thought. <break time="0.8s" /> Grabbing a handful of nuts, she set Lucy down and moved into the room to sit next to her dad. <break time="0.8s" /> He looked up at her as she sat down. <break time="0.8s" /> Messing up her hair, he smiled and asked, Did Lucy wake you up from your beauty sleep, baby. <break time="0.8s" /> He clearly was the one who sent her running into Sallys room. <break time="0.8s" /> Rolling her eyes, she scowled at him. <break time="0.8s" /> She did, Thanks. <break time="0.8s" /> He laughed and turned to his granddaughter. <break time="0.8s" /> He gave her a high five and said, Good job, Lucy. <break time="0.8s" /> Nice, Real nice, Dad, Sally complained softly. <break time="0.8s" /> She watched her dad laugh and pick up Lucy. <break time="0.8s" /> His green eyes danced as he bounced her on his knee. <break time="0.8s" /> His dark blond hair was starting to lighten with grays and silvers. <break time="0.8s" /> Sally got her crazy red curls from his mom, Grandma Sally. <break time="0.8s" /> She used to wish she got his blond hair instead, at least it behaved better than hers. <break time="0.8s" /> But over time, she had embraced her difference and uniqueness from everyone else. <break time="0.8s" /> Watching Lucy, she decided to teach her the same thing. <break time="0.8s" /> Their crazy red curls were special gifts from Grandma and should be cherished.
